semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in high-end wet process equipment for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Liansheng Semiconductor Technology (Wuxi) Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of advanced wet process equipment essential for semiconductor fabrication. Their product offerings include a range of fully automatic cleaning and etching machines designed to enhance semiconductor processing efficiency.
capabilities: Fully automatic etching and thinning cleaning machines

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Xishan Science and Technology Innovation Park, Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province.
